# Elite Surface Group

> Adelaide cladding, render, Hebel and walling specialists serving homes, builders and commercial projects across South Australia.

Elite Surface Group installs and finishes exterior and interior wall systems. Work covers cladding, acrylic and cement render, Hebel panel systems, and coordinated walling packages. Quotes are obligation-free and scoped to the project brief.

## Selected case studies

- [Dark feature cladding](https://elitesurfacegroup.com.au/projects/dark-feature-cladding/): Dark panel cladding around an upper window and garage projection
- [Two-storey exterior render](https://elitesurfacegroup.com.au/projects/two-storey-exterior-render/): Light render across a two-storey residential exterior
- [Curved rendered wall detail](https://elitesurfacegroup.com.au/projects/curved-rendered-wall-detail/): Continuous light finish around a curved upper wall
- [Rendered window reveal detail](https://elitesurfacegroup.com.au/projects/rendered-window-reveal-detail/): Deep rendered return and parapet beside glazing
- [Rendered columns and stone junctions](https://elitesurfacegroup.com.au/projects/rendered-column-and-stone-junctions/): In-progress rendered columns and ledges above a stone-faced base
